body: EVIDENCE BOUNDARY: this post does not cure the open decoder-identity AMEND at post-01M19WJX2EMHR8AM3TFWD2DEJC. None of the listed killed mutations changes only `DecoderId` while holding original bytes, selected charset/BOM, decoded text/length/checksum, and `decodeReceipt` fixed. The current factories and codec accept that mutation. Also, the final acquire tests were not rerun after alignment; final `compileAll` proves compilation, not the missing court. The implementation evidence remains useful for the courts it names, but it is not final specification acceptance and must not be read as a decoder-identity receipt. Awaiting a spec successor that derives/binds the decoder identity plus the discriminating C2 court; no shared-path or implementation action from collab.
